Maya R.: Quick sync — final checks for next Tue webinar. greenroom 20m before. can ops confirm recording + captions exports?

Elena B.: Reg page update: change primary CTA to 'Reserve your seat 8 Apr: benchmarks & demo' and add micro-CTA 'See sample benchmark' under hero linking to a static PNG.

Tom H.: Ops checklist:
```
zoom.cloud_recording=on
zoom.auto_transcription=on
zoom.record_separate_files=on
local_backup=/var/backups/webinars/2026-04-14
s3.bucket=redwood-webinar-exports
s3.path=/2026/04/14/benchmarks/
caption_formats=[.vtt,.srt]
```
Tom H.: We'll set S3 objects to private and grant the editing team IAM read. ops-bot will post path when export completes.
Legal (Sam): Reminder: add an opt-in checkbox for marketing follow-ups on the reg form and include privacy link in confirmation email. no customer screenshots without signed release.
Elena B.: HubSpot list name: wb_apr2026_benchmarks. add property 'initial_touch=webinar_landing' and tag 'benchmarks_track'.
Maya R.: Post-event timeline: T+15m short replay email with 2-min highlight + CTA to trial credits; T+18h full replay + TL;DR + benchmark image; T+72h segmented nurture (benchmarks -> SDR).
ops-bot: Cloud recording started at 3360012398  file pending export.
Tom H.: I'll post S3 object names when export finishes. editing team can pull captions for subtitle burn later.
Maya R.: Owners recap: Landing & CTAs -> Elena; Ops/recording -> Tom; Editing/clips + HubSpot -> Mike (cc'd); Legal compliance -> Sam. everyone OK?

Maya R.: Thanks team  last preflight in 15. see you in the greenroom. :sparkles:
